title: Private Hyannis Walking Food Tour with Local Tastings
includes: Sample a variety of dishes at multiple locally owned restaurants and specialty shops
Indoor and outdoor stops throughout the tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the culinary scene of Hyannis on this walking food tour that takes you through the charming waterfront and historic streets. Sample a variety of freshly prepared dishes from local favorites stopping only at locally owned and operated restaurants and shops . Sweet and savory tastings! All while enjoying fascinating stories from expert guides. Ideal for food lovers, families, and couples looking for a unique dining experience. Comfortable walking shoes are recommended for this appx 3-hour tour covering about a mile.

- Enjoy a diverse selection of local foods from Hyannis' best eateries
- Guided tour featuring insights into the area's history and culinary culture
- Perfect for families and couples, small groups seeking a memorable outing
- 2.5-3 hour walking tour with a route that includes both indoor and outdoor stops
